key_idea: On every night one owl hoots and the other two listen.
steps: The second owl listened to 7 hoots, so it hooted on the other nights: 10 - 7 = 3 hoots.
The first owl hooted 4 times. The third owl hooted the rest: 10 - 4 - 3 = 3 hoots.
The third owl listened when it did not hoot: 10 - 3 = 7 hoots.

choice_feedback.A: 8 would mean the third owl hooted only 2 times. It hooted 3 times.
choice_feedback.C: 6 is how many times the first owl listened, not the third owl.
choice_feedback.D: 5 is too few. The third owl listened on every night it did not hoot: 10 - 3 = 7.
choice_feedback.E: 4 is how many times the first owl hooted.
